name: Malon & The Legend of Zelda: Master of Time
summary: Malon and the Master of Time is a total conversion ROM hack of Ocarina of Time. Replacing Link with Malon as the protagonist, the game follows her journey into the land of Abello, a mysterious world where time has completely frozen. Guided by the fairy Nite, Malon must navigate 8 entirely original dungeons and a massive custom overworld to restore the flow of time. The hack features a revised script to reflect Malon's character, custom animations, and a unique soundtrack, offering over 20 hours of new gameplay.
